name: Gravecourt Hewer
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone 3D-intake concept for Gravecourt Hewer, using the supplied Whetstorm-original inventory painting as the sole visual reference. Show exactly one complete one-handed axe with the reference's broad crescent steel blade, pale bone inlays, restrained bronze fittings, short dark leather-wrapped haft and pommel. Three-quarter view showing solid form and thickness; the entire weapon centered with generous white margin. Isolated on pure white background. No hands, person, writing, text, letters, logo, watermark, floor, or cast shadow.
constraints: 2D planning only. Weapon skin may override the equipped item model. Right- and left-hand grip, stow, animation, clipping, and runtime 3D fit remain unverified.
